items.reason: Entry requires one of several DDR aberrations 'including IDH mutation, PTEN mutation and "BRCAness" signature' for PARP inhibition; the manual's IDH exclusion concerns IDH-wildtype as a GBM criterion, not IDH mutation used as a DDR-deficiency selection for the PARP inhibitor.

note: Primary outcome (candidate_matched_selection = true) holds via the BRCAness/PTEN rows regardless of the IDH decision. Carboplatin is a sensitiser 'to sensitize the tumor to PARP inhibition' (candidate per R6).
